title: Spicy Vietnamese Beef Noodle Soup
description: A flavorful and spicy noodle soup originating from Vietnam. This recipe combines the richness of beef broth with the heat of Vietnamese chili sauce.
instructions: 2. Roast the beef bones in the oven for 30 minutes.
3. In a large pot, combine the roasted bones, beef brisket or chuck, aromatic, and 4 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
4. Strain the broth and discard the solids.
5. Add the pho, chili sauce, fish sauce, and sugar to the broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
6. Slice the cooked beef into thin strips.
7. Cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
8. Assemble the bowls with the noodles, beef, and hot broth.
9. Garnish with black pepper to taste.
